name: Bobble Shop Simulator
storyline:
You are now in charge in the family bobble head shop. Congratulations! Be the bobble head shop owner you were meant to be in Bobble Shop Simulator. There is a lot of work to do, and a lot to learn.
Turn this small store in to a bobble head haven. Fulfill your dreams of being THE bobble head magnate. Make your money, grow your bobble head collection, and expand your store to the max!

Not all bobble heads are the same. Collect a large variety of bobble heads and put them on display. Customers will come from all around to view rare and expensive bobble heads. Can you find the rarest of them all?

All businesses need customers, and the best way to get customers is to advertise. Spread the word about your store and watch the customers pour in using multiple advertising methods.

Take care of day to day business. Deal with customers, stock shelves, manage your inventory. Some day you will be able to afford employees. Reviews will make or break your store, so be sure to stay on top of things.

Make sure your store looks the best it can. Paint your walls, change your floors, purchase more space. Even put up posters of the latest Agree-A-Bobbles.
summary: Take control of your very own bobble head shop. Sell, buy, trade, and repair a large variety of bobble heads and related merchandise. Stock shelves, hire employees, and grow your business. Pay attention though, as these bobble heads sometimes have a mind of their own.
